key_facts: A maternal death occurred almost every 2 minutes in 2023.
risk_factors: Inadequate access to quality health services
complications: High blood pressure during pregnancy (pre-eclampsia and eclampsia)
prevention: Safe abortion services to the full extent of the law
High quality care in pregnancy, and during and after childbirth
Administering drugs such as magnesium sulfate for pre-eclampsia
treatment: Injecting oxytocics immediately after childbirth to reduce the risk of bleeding
Timely management and treatment of complications
